title: VDBE virtual-table IN value-list iteration

scope.rationale: valueFromValueList is the protected source boundary behind sqlite3_vtab_in_first/next: it rejects forged values, positions a Btree cursor, decodes a one-column record into reusable Mem output, and stabilizes ephemeral payloads.
excluded_responsibilities: ValueList construction in virtual-table IN planning
Pinned-C end-to-end planner-produced IN iteration differential

external_source_responsibilities: sqlite3BtreeFirst/Next/Eof/PayloadSize and sqlite3VdbeMemFromBtreeZeroOffset over the exact source-layout cursor
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete private iterator body is assigned. Named cursor operations preserve the exact Btree boundary until native source-layout Btree integration.

inputs: Nullable Mem carrying the protected dynamic ValueList marker, output pointer, first/next selector, and exact cursor operations
outputs: MISUSE, ERROR, DONE, NOMEM, a cursor error, or OK with output pointing at the decoded reusable Mem
contracts.ownership: ValueList and cursor are borrowed. The temporary record Mem is always released. Decoded output belongs to ValueList and ephemeral payload is copied before exposure.
contracts.state_and_results: Output is cleared first. Only a dynamic Mem whose destructor is the private valueListFree identity and whose subtype/type-name match ValueList may be dereferenced. First checks EOF; next propagates cursor status. Successful rows decode the first serial value.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns required connection/Btree locks. Cursor operations may read Btree payload; this unit performs no direct VFS calls.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Forged values are rejected without dereference. Cursor/read/OOM errors leave output null and release temporary record ownership. DONE permits normal iteration completion.

representation_differences: Source Btree calls are grouped into a typed ValueListCursorOperations value backed by the production native Btree cursor and payload owner.
The private destructor identity remains the source-shaped vdbe_mem.valueListFree function pointer rather than a public tag.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace checks hostile-marker rejection, a valid protected ValueList, first-row positioning, one-column serial-type-1 decoding to integer 42, DONE on next, and output-null continuation.
internal_observations: record serial decode and reusable output identity
oracle.normalization: Opaque cursor address is not compared; result, output identity, flags, and integer payload are exact. Pinned-C Btree trace remains pending.

assurance.oom: Ephemeral-output make-writeable returns NOMEM; deterministic source-layout allocation trace remains pending.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Concrete Btree read/lock/crash evidence remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Null and forged marker values are rejected before ValueList dereference.
assurance.continuation: Errors and DONE leave output null; successful output can be overwritten by the next iteration as source specifies.
assurance.performance: One cursor movement, one payload read, and one serial decode per value.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. The frontend's unconditional ERROR substitutes were removed.
